blogs.title: The 1.58-Bit Revolution: Making AI Leaner Without Losing the Brains
blogs.description: An introductory look at how the BitNet b1.58 research is changing the game. This post explains the concept of 'ternary' weights (-1, 0, 1) and how these models can match the intelligence of full-precision giants while being significantly faster and cheaper to run.

blogs.title: Goodbye Floating Point: Why 1-bit LLMs are a Hardware Game Changer
blogs.description: A deep dive into the engineering shift from complex floating-point multiplication to simple integer addition. This post explains how BitNet b1.58 paves the way for a new generation of AI-specific chips that could drastically reduce the energy cost of running large models.

blogs.title: AI in Your Pocket: Bringing High-Performance LLMs to Mobile and Edge Devices
blogs.description: Focusing on the practical implications for consumers, this blog explores how the massive reduction in memory and energy consumption of 1.58-bit models makes it possible to run powerful AI locally on smartphones and IoT devices rather than relying solely on the cloud.

blogs.title: Breaking the Scaling Laws: How BitNet b1.58 Outperforms the Giants
blogs.description: A data-driven comparison between BitNet b1.58 and traditional LLaMA models. This post breaks down the research findings on throughput, latency, and memory usage, showing how a 1.58-bit 70B model can be 4x faster than its full-precision counterparts.
